faqs.q: Sec. 102-163. - Residential water fees outside city.
faqs.a:
Water fees for serving residential facilities outside the corporate limits of the
               city, subject to
section 102-51
, are as follows:
(1)
Tapping fee .....$90.00
(2)
Inspection fee: .....
a.
⅝", ¾", and 1" meters .....$67.50
b.
1½" and larger .....$120.00
(3)
Water system development charges determined from the following schedule:
Type of Residence
Per Unit
a. Single family
$66,980.00
b. Duplex
$50,240.00
c. Multifamily
$33,500.00
(4)
Meter and tap size determined from the following schedule:*
Type of Residence
Meter and Tap Size
a. Single-family
⅝" × ¾" meter and ¾" tap
b. Duplex with individually connected units
⅝" × ¾" meter and ¾" tap
Duplex with single service connection
¾" × ¾" meter and ¾" tap
c. Multifamily:
1. 3—6 units
1" meter and 1" tap
2. 7—18 units
1½" meter and 1½" tap
3. 19 or more units
2" or larger meter and tap
*A larger or smaller meter and equal tap size may be purchased and installed when
                  approved by the utilities director if the total peak demand flow of the property being
                  served, as calculated by the latest edition of the AWWA Manual M22, "Sizing Water
                  Service Lines and Meters," which is hereby adopted by reference, justifies the change.
                  Calculations so made will be submitted to the utilities director for review and approval.
